label: WebGL Game — Core Asset Pack (20) for Z-Image text→image
notes: Designed for fast iteration: mostly seamless tileable textures + a few UI/decal sprites. Outputs are PNGs; use remove-bg tooling if you want cutouts.

defaults.negative: text, watermark, signature, logo, frame, border, vignette, blurry, low-res, jpeg artifacts
